name: codex-scaffold
description: A versioned development baseline for coding-agent projects.

scripts.format: biome format --write .baseline/src .baseline/test packages/create-agent-scaffold/src packages/create-agent-scaffold/test packages/create-agent-scaffold/scripts packages/create-agent-scaffold/tsup.config.ts vitest.config.ts
scripts.lint: biome check .baseline/src .baseline/test packages/create-agent-scaffold/src packages/create-agent-scaffold/test packages/create-agent-scaffold/scripts packages/create-agent-scaffold/tsup.config.ts vitest.config.ts
scripts.build:creator: corepack pnpm --filter create-agent-scaffold build
scripts.build: corepack pnpm build:baseline && corepack pnpm build:creator
scripts.check: corepack pnpm lint && corepack pnpm typecheck && corepack pnpm test && corepack pnpm build && corepack pnpm baseline:skills:check
